resources.string: Hypernova Lens on your Even glasses asking to connect through this app, or to open it.
Hypernova Lens on your glasses asks to reach your Mac through Hypernova. It shows %1$s.
It shows this code. Allow only if it\'s the one on your glasses: Lens can then see your sessions, answer them and send prompts, as this app does.
Hypernova Lens asked for the glasses\' settings.
Hypernova on Even Realities G2 glasses: your sessions at a glance, approvals with a tap, replies read into your earbuds. It reaches your Mac through this app.
Hypernova Lens isn\'t in the Even Hub yet. Once it\'s on your glasses, open it in the Even app on this phone: it asks to connect here, and you allow it once.
Open Hypernova Lens on your glasses while Hypernova runs on this phone, then allow it here.
Put Hypernova Lens on your glasses in the Even app. It isn\'t in the Even Hub yet.
Open it on the glasses: it asks to connect, here or in a notification.
Check the code is the one on your glasses, then Allow.
Tap your glasses, or Connect in Lens, to finish.
Reading, pop-ups, the road and which sessions show, ready for when glasses connect.
Now tap your glasses, or Connect in Lens, to finish
Waiting for a tap on the glasses
Tap your glasses, or Connect in Lens, within 10 minutes to finish.
The glasses can\'t connect: another app on this phone uses port 47380. Hypernova keeps trying.
Another app holds the port Hypernova Lens reaches this app on.
Another app is using the glasses\' port
Hypernova Lens can\'t reach your Mac through this phone while another app holds port %1$d. Hypernova keeps trying; closing that app frees it.
The glasses stop reaching your Mac through this phone at once. They can ask again; you\'d allow them here.
A tap on a reply reads it into your earbuds. On the glasses, “mute” and “unmute”.
The voice and its speed are the ones under Voice → Read aloud above: one setting for this phone and the glasses.
A tone when a session finishes or needs you.
Text shows as soon as it arrives.
Claude\'s words come a few at a time, with pauses at commas and full stops, in step with the voice when a reply is read aloud. Code and approvals show at once.
Hypernova\'s own type, drawn: the glance and approvals in the app\'s look; long replies in the glasses\' built-in font, which scrolls. Slower on the glasses: each change is a picture.
A band over whatever the lens shows: a tap opens it, a swipe puts it away. None while you talk or are read to.
A limit is hit or lifted
The Mac is about to sleep
On a bike or a walk
Two short lines on the lens, one sentence per result, a chime per pop-up. Risky commands only by saying “approve push”.
Only what needs you gets through, and the Mac\'s low-battery and about-to-sleep warnings.
Practise the gestures on the glasses
Open Hypernova Lens on your glasses first
Sessions that work, need you, or finished in the last 45 minutes; four at most, the one that needs you first.
